# ex_saml v1.1.2 - Table of Contents

> SAML 2.0 Service Provider (SP) library for Elixir/Phoenix applications.
Enables SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO, Single Logout, SP metadata generation,
and multi-IdP support with pluggable assertion storage.

## Modules

- [ExSaml](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.md): SAML 2.0 Service Provider (SP) library for Elixir/Phoenix applications.
- [ExSaml.Assertion](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Assertion.md): SAML assertion returned from IDP upon successful user authentication.
- [ExSaml.AuthHandler](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.AuthHandler.md): Handles SAML authentication requests (sign-in and sign-out) with the Identity Provider.
- [ExSaml.AuthorizationCodeCache](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.AuthorizationCodeCache.md): TTL-based authorization code cache.
- [ExSaml.BoostrapProvidersLoader](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.BoostrapProvidersLoader.md): GenServer that loads SAML providers after the application and database are ready.
Uses retry logic to handle cases where the database isn't available yet.

- [ExSaml.Core](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.md): Pure Elixir SAML 2.0 core library.
- [ExSaml.Core.Assertion](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Assertion.md): Represents a SAML Assertion element.
- [ExSaml.Core.AuthnRequest](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.AuthnRequest.md): Represents a SAML AuthnRequest message.
- [ExSaml.Core.Binding](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Binding.md): SAML HTTP binding handlers.
- [ExSaml.Core.Contact](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Contact.md): Represents a SAML ContactPerson element.
- [ExSaml.Core.IdpMetadata](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.IdpMetadata.md): Represents SAML Identity Provider metadata.
- [ExSaml.Core.LogoutRequest](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.LogoutRequest.md): Represents a SAML LogoutRequest message.
- [ExSaml.Core.LogoutResponse](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.LogoutResponse.md): Represents a SAML LogoutResponse message.
- [ExSaml.Core.Org](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Org.md): Represents a SAML Organization element.
- [ExSaml.Core.Response](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Response.md): Represents a SAML Response message.
- [ExSaml.Core.Saml](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Saml.md): Core SAML protocol module for encoding and decoding SAML messages.
- [ExSaml.Core.Sp](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Sp.md): SAML Service Provider (SP) operations.
- [ExSaml.Core.SpConfig](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.SpConfig.md): Represents a SAML Service Provider configuration.
- [ExSaml.Core.SpMetadata](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.SpMetadata.md): Represents SAML Service Provider metadata.
- [ExSaml.Core.Subject](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Subject.md): Represents a SAML Subject element within an Assertion.
- [ExSaml.Core.Util](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Util.md): Utility functions for SAML processing.
- [ExSaml.Core.Xml.C14n](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Xml.C14n.md): XML Canonicalization (C14N) for xmerl data structures.
- [ExSaml.Core.Xml.Dsig](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Core.Xml.Dsig.md): XML Digital Signatures (XMLDSig) generation and verification.
- [ExSaml.ErrorMessages](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.ErrorMessages.md): Error messages
- [ExSaml.Metadata](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Metadata.md): Public entry point for validating SAML 2.0 metadata documents.
- [ExSaml.Metadata.ValidationResult](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Metadata.ValidationResult.md): Result of a call to `ExSaml.Metadata.validate/1` or `ExSaml.Metadata.validate/2`.
- [ExSaml.Provider](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Provider.md): SAML 2.0 Service Provider.
- [ExSaml.ProvidersLoader](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.ProvidersLoader.md): Module to configure SAMLY using SP and IDP present in DB

- [ExSaml.RelayStateCache](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.RelayStateCache.md): TTL-based relay state cache with anti-replay protection.
- [ExSaml.Router](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Router.md): Main SAML router. Forward this in your Phoenix router
- [ExSaml.SPHandler](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.SPHandler.md): Handles Service Provider SAML responses: metadata generation, assertion consumption,
and logout handling.
- [ExSaml.SecurityPlug](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.SecurityPlug.md): Plug that sets security headers on SAML responses.
- [ExSaml.State](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.State.md): Interface for SAML assertion storage.
- [ExSaml.State.Cache](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.State.Cache.md): Stores SAML assertions using a Nebulex cache backend.
- [ExSaml.State.ETS](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.State.ETS.md): Stores SAML assertion in ETS.
- [ExSaml.State.Session](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.State.Session.md): Stores SAML assertion in Plug session.
- [ExSaml.State.Store](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.State.Store.md): Specification for ExSaml state stores.

- [ExSaml.Subject](https://ex-saml.hexdocs.pm/ExSaml.Subject.md): The subject in a SAML 2.0 Assertion.
